title: dysoxylum simile
intro: Dysoxylum simile, commonly known as Simarouba, is a plant species belonging to the family Simaroubaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, fever, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Dysoxylum simile include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
